changes: Rebuilt the accepted sample jointly over fiscal years 1994–2005. The Compustat source window is fiscal years 1993–2006 to supply the original t−1 and t+1 inputs; t_base is 1994–2005. CCM link-date and CRSP daily bounds now extend through December 31, 2006. Current local source coverage supports FY2006 leads and CRSP matching through the requested FY2005 endpoint.

Retained the accepted Equation (2) construction and estimator: the same annual within-year temporary-BTD quintile ranks, screens, adjacent-year currency requirement, average-assets scaling, pooled 1st/99th percentile resets, full-sample interacted OLS terms, and conventional OLS inference. Construction, historical and added years were rebuilt together from the named current local sources.

Added an e(sample)-based diagnostic to the existing table3_panel_b cell. It counts firm-year rows for original fiscal years 1994–2000 and added fiscal years 2001–2005, then prints the maximum added fyear. fyear was retained in the handoff and its case, numeric type, format, and fiscal-year units were checked.
limitations: The source reports 14,106 firm-years and 4,048 firms for its 1994–2000 final sample. The accepted predecessor local reconstruction had 15,609 firm-years and 4,572 firms in those years; the fresh pooled replay has 22,035 observations including 6,426 added firm-years. The predecessor local interaction estimates (−0.0904 and −0.2239) also differed from the paper estimates (−0.100 and −0.212). These sample and estimate differences are carried forward without tuning.

The source screens Compustat-identified NOLs. The accepted construction uses observed positive TLCF as a best-effort NOL flag because the current catalog does not verify a separate NOL field; missing TLCF remains unknown rather than zero. The predecessor final sample had 5,687 rows with missing TLCF, so exact NOL exclusion remains unresolved in the extension.

The accepted current-tax screen follows the paper item formula TXT−TXDI and retains unavailable formula inputs as unknown. In the predecessor comparison, direct TXC differed from TXT−TXDI in 3,627 of 69,578 observed rows (5.21%); 29 predecessor final rows had unknown formula status. The formula and unknown-status policy were kept.

Other inherited specification limits remain: the paper does not give exact average-assets timing, numeric SIC cutoffs, the CRSP link-selection rules, the current-vintage mapping for the NOL screen, or a covariance correction. The accepted construction uses the mean of AT(t−1,t) and AT(t,t+1), SIC 4900–4999 and 6000–6999, time-valid P/C and LC/LU links with daily CRSP presence, and conventional OLS standard errors.

Pooled winsorization cutoffs were recalculated on the joint 1994–2005 eligible sample, as required by the accepted construction. The coefficient comparison therefore reflects both added years and the refreshed pooled cutoffs.
